user_text: Perfect, that's done. I'm pretty tired, honestly.
text:
That's understandable — building out a full unit like that takes a lot of mental energy. You put in solid work getting those draft goals together; the hard thinking was already in place before the refinement.

When you come back to it fresh, a couple of things worth doing next:

- **Build or pull your rubrics** for those three assessments while the scoring criteria are still clear in your mind.
- **Decide on your mutation model format** (physical vs. digital) so you can prep materials for Week 1.

But that can all wait. Go rest. You earned it.
